artDirection: Architecture bretonne modeste, expressive et décalée, formes rondes et gros contours noirs dans le style de Sylvain.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a finished 1536x1024 landscape 3:2 neighbourhood map illustration for the French cartoon game Le Placard.
REFERENCE: the attached Sylvain mascot is the EXACT drawing style to extend into an environment. Match its BIG smooth BLACK contours, rounded rubbery shapes, bold silhouette, extremely simple FLAT cream/tan/turquoise colour fills, black shadow shapes and sparse halftone dot patches. Imagine the very same illustrator drawing Sylvain's home village. Do not copy the character into the map: extend its visual language into architecture.
Art direction: a mischievous and slightly absurd working-class Breton village. The buildings should have the warmth, swagger and comic elasticity of Sylvain himself: squat, crooked, bulging, jaunty roofs, oversized rounded doors, chunky repaired wood, bent chimneys. Expressive wonky architecture, humorous but still functional and recognisable. Strong silhouette over tiny detail. Flat 2D retro editorial cartoon / comic, absolutely NOT a realistic village, not a polite miniature, not a 3D toy render, not a polished tourist resort.
Scene design: EIGHT small, modest individual destinations, separated by generous uncluttered cream sandy paths and simple green grass. Three-quarter elevated map view with readable facades. Keep every building's entire outline inside the frame and do NOT let buildings overlap. Their approximate centres and identities:
- Upper left (23%,23%): a squat converted Breton farm garage/warehouse, sagging broad slate roof, comically large rounded turquoise double doors, one crooked vent, a timber repair patch and two wonky crates; looks cobbled together with affection, not industrial or luxurious.
- Upper middle (52%,17%): a TINY local bank in a squat stone cottage with a very large heavy rounded safe-like front door and an oversized coin sign on a slightly bent bracket; a stubby angled chimney. No columns, palace, marble or roof-mounted giant pig.
- Upper right (80%,26%): a small administrative office in a lopsided Breton cottage, crooked roof, green shutters, little black-and-white Breton flag, an exaggerated stack of papers visible through one window.
- Middle left (21%,55%): one compact wooden market stand, jaunty patched cream and ochre awning, oversized round vegetables, two crates stacked imperfectly. Clear unified silhouette.
- Lower middle (50%,74%): a small bulging shop, friendly crooked turquoise striped awning, wide rounded storefront, one swinging blank wood sign and a stool. Modest, funny, characterful.
- Lower right (80%,66%): modest village judging/festival shed with a wonky slate roof, chunky timber stage, three mismatched stools and a disproportionately proud golden trophy badge. No Roman arena, no stadium.
- Centre (49%,44%): a chunky timber missions noticeboard kiosk with one tiny tilted slate roof, a handful of large cream pinned sheets, asymmetric legs. No writing.
- Lower left (26%,82%): tiny collector's hut, a slanted patched roof, oversized collectible card silhouettes inside a rounded window, squat door and little step.
Breton identity: only a few large simplified granite stones, curved deep petrol slate roofs with a SMALL number of broad tile marks, cream stone walls with sparse stone outlines, turquoise shutters, three or four stylised rounded hydrangea clumps, yellow gorse. A narrow bold turquoise stream curves along right and lower edge with a tiny slightly wonky wood bridge. Keep landscape SIMPLE and graphic with open negative space, no dense forest or repetitive stone detail.
Palette: Sylvain's turquoise #008b80, deep green #00563f, warm cream #f7ebdd, tan #cf9d73, black, touches of mustard yellow. Avoid cold grey-blue dominance and photoreal vegetation. Strong black cartoon outlines around the buildings, limited flat shadows and sparse ink halftone, no painted gradient lighting.
Technical constraints: full-bleed 3:2 map. Eight distinct destinations only. No UI, no text, no numbers, no labels, no border or boxes or highlight frames, no watermark. Clear visible uninterrupted roof/wall silhouettes for exact interactive masks. The personality must come from comic architecture and purposeful little visual gags, not from drawn eyes or mouths on buildings.
